comment: Probe for 0.5.0 observation.shadow_dom on a real page: the Polymer shop keeps every control in nested open shadow roots (without the option the table is empty). Written 2026-11-17 after a Playwright probe of the observer, not from memory.
goal: Open Men's Outerwear, open the product 'Men's Tech Shell Full-Zip', choose size L and add it to the cart, so that the cart says it holds 1 item.

goal_reached.when: A message says the item was added to the cart, or the shopping cart button says it holds 1 item

wrong_item.when: The product page or the cart shows a product other than Men's Tech Shell Full-Zip

app_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown
